messages:
Maya: morning handoff from my night shift — quick summary and TL;DR: we had a partial degradation of embedding creation for a subset of customers between 23:10-23:48 UTC, root cause was an autoscaler mis-evaluating GPU utilization after a model micro-update. Impact: ~5% of embedding requests returned 503s or timed out, mostly short requests (<=64 tokens). No data loss, latency mostly normal for successful requests.

Maya: pages fired at 23:15, I acknowledged and ran through runbook 'embeddings/503-degrade-v2' (link: https://go/redwood-runbooks/embeddings/503-degrade-v2). Primary mitigation was to scale the dedicated pool back to the pre-update size and bump model fallback policy to the non-quantized variant. That eliminated the 503s by 23:48.

Incidents Bot: Pager received: PAGER-1489 — Embedding generation 503s (sev3) — 23:14 UTC.

Tariq: thanks — did we roll back the micro-update or only adjusted scaling?

Maya: we did not rollback the model artifact. Steps taken:
- adjusted autoscaler target from 0.6 -> 0.45 (temporary)
- increased burst capacity by adding 2 nodes to the dedicated pool via infra autoscale command
- applied fallback route for customers with high error rate to the older quantized model variant (policy ID: fb/2026-03-13-emb).

Maya: commands used:
```bash
# scale dedicated pool
rwctl pool scale --pool embeddings-dedicated-west --nodes +2 --reason "handoff emergency"
# adjust autoscaler threshold
rwctl autoscaler update --target-util 0.45 --pool embeddings-dedicated-west
```

Leah: any customer-facing pages or CS tickets opened?

Maya: CS ticket created for affected customers with >1% error rate (internal ID CS-9042). We proactively emailed customers with degraded experience — template used: https://go/redwood-templates/embeddings-degrade. No major customers reported data corruption; one mid-market customer saw intermittent failures in production ML pipelines and is flagged for follow-up (account: AcmeAnalytics).

Ben: what about alerts — are we still seeing elevated error rate?

Maya: error rate is back to baseline as of 23:50 UTC. Postmortem metrics: peak error rate ~5.1% at 23:22, rolling 5m normalized to 1.8% by 23:40 after mitigation. No repeat occurrences overnight.

SRE Rotation Bot: Reminder: primary tonight is TARIQ, secondary is BEN. On-call rotation link: https://go/oncall-schedule.

Tariq: I can take primary. Quick notes for next shift: check autoscaler logs (service: embeddings-autoscaler) for the window 22:50-23:30 UTC, and verify kernel-level GPU metrics (nvml) to ensure utilization signals weren't noisy.

Maya: file paths and quick grep I used: 
```bash
# get autoscaler events
logs query --service=embeddings-autoscaler --from=2026-03-13T22:50Z --to=2026-03-13T23:40Z '
"scale" OR "target_util"'
# nvml snapshot
metrics fetch --host=gpu-prod-12 --metric nvml_util --from=2026-03-13T22:50Z --to=2026-03-13T23:40Z
```

Leah: any runbook gaps discovered?

Maya: yes — runbook didn't explicitly call out a fallback route for quantized->non-quantized variant pairing; I updated the runbook (patch queued: https://go/runbooks/edit/embeddings/503-degrade-v2) and added a checklist item to verify SLO routing rules after any model artifact push. I left a TODO for product: add model push gating that validates autoscaler behaviour against a canary traffic slice.

Tariq: noted. For immediate actions tonight I'm going to:
- validate autoscaler health alerts are configured (alert name: embeddings.autoscaler.unexpected_target_change)
- add a short synthetic test hitting embeddings endpoint with small payloads every 30s for canary customers
- keep fallback policy on standby for 12h then remove if stable

Ben: I'll monitor customer support queue for any new hits from AcmeAnalytics and escalate if repeat failures. Also happy to be secondary on-call for the next 24h.

Maya: handoff checklist items (what I did + what I leave you with):
- Incident summary: embeddings 503 spike due to autoscaler mis-eval
- Mitigations applied: scale up pool, lower autoscaler target, fallback route to non-quantized model
- Customer follow-ups: CS-9042, AcmeAnalytics priority flag
- Runbook change: added fallback pairing step + gating TODO
- Dashboards to watch: embeddings-error-rate (p95/p50), embeddings-autoscaler-target, gpu-util-nvml
- Links: runbook https://go/redwood-runbooks/embeddings/503-degrade-v2, post-incident slack thread archive https://go/slack-archive/2865009876

Leah: thanks Maya. Any remaining open items requiring infra or product engagement?

Maya: product needs to approve the proposed gating by EOD next business day. Infra action: perform a healthcheck on the autoscaler service during low traffic window (I've assigned infra ticket INFRA-771).

Tariq: I'll pick up the infra healthcheck and enqueue a quick canary script. If anything spikes I'll page and post updates here.

Incidents Bot: PAGER-1489 closed at 2026-03-13T23:50:02Z by Maya.

Maya: passing primary to Tariq now — please ack and confirm you have the runbook links and CS tickets. :wave:

Tariq: ack — got runbook and CS-9042. Will monitor for 12h and keep fallback policy live for now.

Ben: ack secondary. I'll watch the support queue and dashboards.

Leah: acknowledged, leaving a note in the product board about gating (ticket PROD-1337). Good handoff. :thumbsup:

Maya: thanks team — handoff complete. If no pages, I'll check back in next day for any follow-ups.
